translation:
<ins>Bamboo Leaf and Gypsum Decoction (竹葉石膏湯)</ins>
Bamboo leaf (竹葉, three handfuls), gypsum (石膏, one jin), ginseng (人參, three liang), licorice (甘草, honey-fried, two liang), ophiopogon (麥冬, one sheng), pinellia (半夏, half sheng), polished round-grained rice (粳米, half sheng)
With the guiding herb fresh ginger (生薑), decoct in water and take. <ins>Four Substances Decoction (四物湯)</ins> and <ins>Supplementing the Middle and Benefiting Qi Decoction (補中益氣湯)</ins> (both are found under injury with bleeding, 傷損出血)
<ins>Eight Treasures Decoction (八珍湯)</ins> (the formula is found under diffusion and settling of stagnant blood, 瘀血泛注)
<ins>Six-Ingredient Rehmannia Pill (六味地黃丸)</ins> (the formula is found under pain in the muscles, 肌肉作痛)
